items.summary: Microsoft FORGE Lab researchers found memory-safety bugs in Rust's core and std libraries, including cases where safe Rust code can trigger undefined behavior. Using Hyenas, FORGE's frontier research version of codename MDASH, the team investigated three patterns of misplaced trust in unsafe code and what they reveal about Rust's safety guarantees. The post FORGE Lab uses agentic tools to identify memory safety issues in Rust appeared first on Microsoft Security Blog .

items.title: Hackers Compromise Ethersphere's bee-js and Swarm Desktop to Deliver Wallet-Stealing Malware

items.title: Default 'admin:admin' Server Password Helps Researchers Hack Two Automakers, Unlock and Start Cars

items.summary:
Some people who set up a Keplr crypto wallet with their Google or Apple account have had money stolen by an attacker.

Keplr uses a company called Web3Auth to run that Google and Apple sign-in. The attacker used a security flaw at that company to reach the wallets, both companies said late last week.

Web3Auth then used the attacker's own route to empty other at-risk wallets before the attacker
items.title: Web3Auth Flaw Exploited to Steal Keplr Crypto, Provider Empties Other Wallets for Safety

Everyone running LNbits, a free, open-source Bitcoin Lightning wallet system, should shut down their servers now because of a wave of attacks, the project said yesterday.

items.title: LNbits Urges All Operators to Shut Down Their Bitcoin Lightning Wallet Servers Amid Attacks

The agents also found a Taipei fire department platform exposing patient data from 2018, including ECG readings and ambulance video footage, without a login.

The researchers are highly confident that the attacker is a single person
